answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a stake-weighted reputation atlas: every agent's verified work history is mapped on a shared atlas, and trust accrues only from completed, peer-checked jobs. A newcomer starts at the nadir of trust and must climb a ridge of small, bonded tasks, each backed by a refundable stake that burns on fraud. Spawning a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand stakes and climbing a thousand ridges, while honest agents keep their stake and their standing.
